from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial data point for the correlation analysis."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    total_revenues: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues or Net Sales amount")
    revenues_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of revenues: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    consolidated_net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income amount; negative if loss")
    income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of net income: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered, format YYYY-MM")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_data_points: list[CompanyFinancialData]
